What sorting and filtering each cover

Ascending and descending: Ascending goes small to large (1, 2, 3); descending goes large to small (3, 2, 1). "Newest on top" is creation time descending.

State the default sort: The order on open is the default sort. Specifying "newest by creation time" keeps the AI from picking an arbitrary alphabetical order.

What it is not

Sorting is not filtering: filtering narrows the list, sorting reorders it without losing a record—they often combine, filtering "following up" then sorting by amount. Pinning a row to the top is also not sorting; it manually pins one record and leaves the rest untouched.
